title: multiple-event-groups-using-event-builder.md
content: ## Metadata_Start ## code: en ## title: Using the Event Builder ## slug: multiple-event-groups-using-event-builder ## seoTitle: Using the Event Builder ## description: ## contentType: Markdown ## Metadata_End Event Organizers working in the {{variable.Component_EventBuilder}} can add or remove associations between single {{variable.Object_Event}}s and multiple {{variable.Object_EventGroup}}s when creating a new {{variable.Object_Event}}, editing an existing {{variable.Object_Event}}, or cloning an {{variable.Object_Event}}. ## Event Builder Updates * The {{variable.Field_ETEvent_EventGroup}} field in the {{variable.Component_EventBuilder}}’s Event Details section is now called {{variable.Field_Event_PrimaryEventGroup}}. * The {{variable.Field_EV_EventGroupAssociation}} multi-select lookup field is also in the Event Details section. Event Organizers can create or delete {{variable.Object_EventGroupAssociation}}s from the {{variable.Field_EV_EventGroupAssociation}} field. ![Event Builder_Primary Event Group Field](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/Event%20Builder_Primary%20Event%20Group%20Field.png){height="" width=""} ### Use Cases #### Case 1 If an Event Organizer updates an {{variable.Object_Event}}’s {{variable.Field_Event_PrimaryEventGroup}} field to “EventGroup1,” and the {{variable.Object_Event}} has no related {{variable.Object_EventGroupAssociation}} records in the {{variable.Component_EventBuilder}}, the {{variable.Object_Event}} will be related to the {{variable.Object_EventGroupAssociation}} record with {{variable.Field_EVGrpAssoc_Event}} (conference360__Event__c) = "this event" and {{variable.Field_EVGrpAssoc_EventGroup}} (conference360__Event_Group__c) = "EventGroup1." #### Case 2 An Event Organizer creates or modifies an {{variable.Object_Event}} in the {{variable.Component_EventBuilder}}. The {{variable.Object_Event}}’s {{variable.Field_Event_PrimaryEventGroup}} field is blank, and the {{variable.Object_Event}} has no related {{variable.Object_EventGroupAssociation}} records in the {{variable.Component_EventBuilder}}. If they set the {{variable.Field_EV_EventGroupAssociation}} field to “EventGroup1,” the {{variable.Field_Event_PrimaryEventGroup}} field is automatically set to “EventGroup1.” After saving the {{variable.Object_Event}} and opening the {{variable.Object_Event}} record, the Event Organizer can see that the {{variable.Object_Event}} is related to the {{variable.Object_EventGroupAssociation}} record: {{variable.Field_EVGrpAssoc_Event}} (conference360__Event__c) = "this event," {{variable.Field_EVGrpAssoc_EventGroup}} (conference360__Event_Group__c) = "Event Group1.” #### Case 3 An Event Organizer uses the {{variable.Component_EventBuilder}} to edit an {{variable.Object_Event}} with the {{variable.Field_Event_PrimaryEventGroup}} field set to “EventGroup1” and the {{variable.Field_EV_EventGroupAssociation}} field set to “EventGroup1.” They delete “EventGroup1” from the {{variable.Field_EV_EventGroupAssociation}} field, automatically removing the “EventGroup1” value from the {{variable.Field_Event_PrimaryEventGroup}} field. After saving the {{variable.Object_Event}} and opening the {{variable.Object_Event}} record, the Event Organizer can see that the {{variable.Object_Event}} no longer has any related {{variable.Object_EventGroupAssociation}} records. #### Case 4 An {{variable.Object_Event}} has the {{variable.Field_Event_PrimaryEventGroup}} field set to “EventGroup1” and the {{variable.Field_EV_EventGroupAssociation}} field set to “EventGroup1.” If an Event Organizer uses the {{variable.Component_EventBuilder}} to remove “EventGroup1” from the {{variable.Field_Event_PrimaryEventGroup}} field, then “EventGroup1” will automatically be removed from the {{variable.Field_EV_EventGroupAssociation}} field. After saving the {{variable.Object_Event}} and opening the {{variable.Object_Event}} record, the Event Organizer can see that the {{variable.Object_Event}} no longer has any related {{variable.Object_EventGroupAssociation}} records. #### Case 5 An {{variable.Object_Event}} has the {{variable.Field_Event_PrimaryEventGroup}} field set to “EventGroup1” and the {{variable.Field_EV_EventGroupAssociation}} field set to “EventGroup1,” “EventGroup2,” and “EventGroup3.” If an Event Organizer uses the {{variable.Component_EventBuilder}} to remove “EventGroup1” from the {{variable.Field_Event_PrimaryEventGroup}} field, then “EventGroup1” will automatically be removed from the {{variable.Field_EV_EventGroupAssociation}} field. After saving the {{variable.Object_Event}} and opening the {{variable.Object_Event}} record, the Event Organizer can see that the {{variable.Object_Event}}’s {{variable.Field_Event_PrimaryEventGroup}} field is automatically set to “EventGroup2” since “EventGroup2” is now the oldest option. The Event is still related to the following {{variable.Object_EventGroupAssociation}}n records. * {{variable.Object_EventGroupAssociation}}: {{variable.Field_EVGrpAssoc_Event}} (conference360__Event__c) = "this event," {{variable.Field_EVGrpAssoc_EventGroup}} (conference360__Event_Group__c) = "EventGroup2" * {{variable.Object_EventGroupAssociation}}: {{variable.Field_EVGrpAssoc_Event}} (conference360__Event__c) = "this event," {{variable.Field_EVGrpAssoc_EventGroup}} (conference360__Event_Group__c) = "EventGroup3" #### Case 6 An {{variable.Object_Event}} has the {{variable.Field_Event_PrimaryEventGroup}} field set to “EventGroup1” and the {{variable.Field_EV_EventGroupAssociation}} field set to “EventGroup1,” “EventGroup2,” and “EventGroup3.” If an Event Organizer uses the {{variable.Component_EventBuilder}} to remove “EventGroup1” from the {{variable.Field_EV_EventGroupAssociation}} field, then the {{variable.Field_Event_PrimaryEventGroup}} field will automatically be set to “EventGroup2” since it's now the oldest option. After saving the {{variable.Object_Event}} and opening the {{variable.Object_Event}} record, the Event Organizer can see that the {{variable.Object_Event}} is related to the following {{variable.Object_EventGroupAssociation}} records. * {{variable.Object_EventGroupAssociation}}: {{variable.Field_EVGrpAssoc_Event}} (conference360__Event__c) = "this event," {{variable.Field_EVGrpAssoc_EventGroup}} (conference360__Event_Group__c) = "EventGroup2" * {{variable.Object_EventGroupAssociation}}: {{variable.Field_EVGrpAssoc_Event}} (conference360__Event__c) = "this event," {{variable.Field_EVGrpAssoc_EventGroup}} (conference360__Event_Group__c) = "EventGroup3"
